answer: The strongest proof is the one the applicant forgot. Library membership record with decade-long borrowing history is that forgotten proof: a card the library has stamped on every return since 2013. The haven of it is the accident - a record made for another purpose, in another decade, before this epoch existed. A farm cannot plant a hundred accidents: the nectar of an accident is its timing - it must predate the reward, and no reward existed when these records were made. The oasis the verifier reads is the date line: it cannot be backdated without a mark.
